title: Mode-specific launch setup
summary: This release makes companion apps fit your Desktop and OpenXR launch modes.
highlights: Assign every companion app to Desktop, VR, or both, so each Steam launch starts only the helpers you want.
SteamVR is now an optional built-in VR-only helper: select its vrstartup.exe path and enable it when you want it started before LMU.
Existing launchers refresh automatically after valid mode or companion changes, without copying Steam launch options again.
